title: The rule of 72
hook_variants: Bankers use one number to see the future of your money. It's seventy-two.
Want to know when your money doubles? Divide by seventy-two.
The math trick schools forgot to teach you.

scenes.say: One number tells you when your money doubles. Seventy-two.
Take seventy-two. Divide it by your yearly return. That's how many years to double.
Two percent? Thirty-six years. Six percent? Twelve. Nine percent? Just eight.
Put in ten thousand at twenty, earn nine percent, and by sixty it has doubled five times.
scenes.label: AT AGE 60 (5 DOUBLINGS)

scenes.say: It works for debt too. Twenty-four percent on a credit card doubles what you owe in three years.
Follow Landed Costs for money math in thirty seconds.

caption:
72 ÷ your yearly return = years to double your money. Works for credit card debt too (that's the scary part). 📈
